stem.en: Carbon dioxide makes up 0.04% of the air by volume. In a sample of 2500 cm3 of air, how many cm3 of it are carbon dioxide? Give the answer in cm3.

explanation.en: 0.04 per cent means 0.04 parts in every 100. So 2500 x 0.04 / 100 = 1 cm3 of carbon dioxide.

hints.en: Write 0.04 per cent as a fraction: 0.04/100.
